fixtures.preview: Pochettino's first home game, 3pm UK time Sat 28 Nov (2am Sun in Sydney), after the 4-0 loss at Liverpool and a 2-2 Champions League draw with Sporting.
talking_points: Khel Now has United in the relegation zone with one league win from 11, one of their worst Premier League starts.
Brentford are sixth, beat Everton 4-0 on Monday and have scored in each of their last six meetings with United (United lead the head-to-head 10 wins to 5).
United are without Baleba, Rashford, Sesko and Ugarte, and Amad Diallo is a doubt after a knock against Sporting, per Centre Devils.
Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool was overturned so he is available, while Brentford are missing suspended striker Igor Thiago and several defenders.

fixtures.preview: A Wednesday-night trip to Newcastle at 8pm UK time (7am Thursday in Sydney); Sky notes fixtures are subject to change.
A Saturday 3pm home game (2am Sunday in Sydney), the second of three league games in eight days.
A Saturday 3pm trip to south London (2am Sunday in Sydney), per Sky's schedule.
A Saturday 3pm trip to north London (2am Sunday in Sydney); I couldn't confirm the Australian broadcaster.
The first men's Big Blue of the season, after a weekend off for Sydney.
talking_points: Sydney drew 0-0 away to Brisbane Roar and sit third on the ladder after five rounds, with four points from their last two games.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo called his side 'a bit sloppy' before half-time but praised their second-half reaction.
Jacob Farrell made his debut after a long injury layoff, and injuries and thin depth have forced several young players into debuts.
Oriola Sunday came closest to a late winner against Brisbane.

fixtures.preview: A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm NZ time (3pm Sydney), Matchweek 8.
Saturday 2 Jan home game; the club's fixture article gives the date but I couldn't find a kick-off time.

notes: Searches were thin again this run: WebSearch returned mostly stale pages and several official sites (Stan, BBC, Rebel, Nike, Coles, Woolworths) were blocked or empty, so most sections carry over from the previous run. Re-checked: Time Out and Ellaslist weekend guides, City of Sydney What's On, Opera House listings, OzBargain's Black Friday tag and the school pages.

Changes this run: the finished Ireland v Australia match and the ended Krispy Kreme deal were removed; two Black Friday sports deals and three school dates (Year 6 Luna Park day, stage assemblies) were added. No new team news could be opened, so previews are from 26–27 Nov and line-ups are unconfirmed. No grocery list for the week from 2 Dec was available yet.

Man Utd: Brentford talking points come from Khel Now and Centre Devils (26–27 Nov); Amad Diallo is described as a doubt, and line-ups aren't confirmed. Arsenal away (19 Dec, 3pm UK) is on Sky's schedule but the Australian broadcaster wasn't confirmed.

Sydney FC: the A-Leagues fixture guide confirms Victory (6 Dec) and Auckland away (12 Dec, 5pm NZ). The Perth, Macarthur and Brisbane dates and the Big Blue talking points come from earlier club sources and weren't re-opened; the 2 Jan kick-off time is a 12:00 placeholder.

Big matches: the Nations Championship, Everton v Liverpool and Arsenal v Man City entries were not re-checked, and Stan Sport's rights couldn't be confirmed from Stan's own site. Champions League matchday 6 is 8–9 Dec, but sources disagreed on pairings, so none were added.
Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas/Socceroos home games were found in the next four weeks. The Kings v Wildcats time is from a third-party listing.

Local: school dates come from the Term 4 primary and high school calendars and the Week 7 Principal Updates and may change. Nothing was found for the second school. Rosina's Hot Table (19 Nov) is older than 7 days and was dropped, and no dated local news from the last week was found. The Alexandria Christmas Concert (13 Dec) is carried over from last run. Trials listed last run aren't in the Week 7 updates, so they were removed.

Groceries: Woolworths and Coles half-price items for 25 Nov–1 Dec come from an OzBargain catalogue roundup (reopened this run). No Aldi prices were found, and no half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs, nuts or matcha appeared.

Deals: Rebel's and Nike's Black Friday pages were blocked, so no football-boot discounts are listed. Many links go to OzBargain posts, so check the retailer before buying. Most deals carry over from last run and weren't individually re-checked.

Arts: Pub Choir's 6pm start comes from a third-party listing, and prices weren't confirmed for several Opera House and Frontier shows. Whispering Jack was removed because I couldn't confirm its dates.
Son and daughter: no junior parkrun, Roblox, Pokémon event or children's author event was confirmed. Noa Matcha's listing gives conflicting dates and venues, so check the booking page.
